---
name: Performance report
about: Report a performance regression or share a reproducible benchmark
---

## What did you observe?

Describe the workload and the result you expected, including a baseline if
available. Attach relevant profiles or measurements.

## How can we reproduce it?

Include the query or operation, data and index characteristics, build and
configuration, measurement method, hardware, and software versions. Explain
how results were checked for correctness and note any background load or other
limitations.
